No public parcel viewer, service URL, layer schema, or safe anonymous parcel geometry endpoint was found.

queries.result: No first-party Igbo-language cadastral viewer or public parcel-geometry service was located. English official sources were retained because Nigeria's official land-service material and the state ministry pages reviewed publish the relevant procedures in English; this is a discovery limitation, not evidence of absence.

registryEvidence.custodian: Ebonyi State Ministry of Lands and Survey / Office of the Surveyor-General, with procedures located at Block II Centenary City Secretariat, Ochudo City, Abakaliki.
registryEvidence.scope: State/local land-registration and survey custody is evidenced by official ministry pages and certificate-of-occupancy procedures naming the Abakaliki office; this does not establish a public parcel-map API or citywide geometry coverage.

source.name: Ebonyi State Ministry of Lands and Survey

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: State Ministry of Lands and Survey and the Office of the Surveyor-General are evidenced as the relevant land-registration/survey custodians for Abakaliki; official budget/procedure documents mention digitization/GIS and analogue-map upgrading.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No safe anonymous parcel ID+geometry response or public vector layer was verified. The exact WUP point was not shifted and no point hit/miss was treated as an absence result.

technicalBlocker: No first-party public viewer configuration or parcel feature endpoint with safe minimal fields was found. The eblands.online registration/data pages were not usable for anonymous schema inspection (HTTP 406), and no geometry request was made to avoid unsafe registration/property fields.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the state land-information/GIS work has a current public vector service, what its native parcel identity and CRS are, and whether it covers the unchanged WUP settlement point.
nextStep: Revisit only if an official public vector endpoint or viewer configuration is documented; qualify metadata and a bounded safe ID+geometry response before runtime admission.
pointBasis: WUP 2025 settlement point in latitude/longitude order; not a municipal boundary or parcel-coverage claim.
